metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for RTL design and verification engineers: evidence-gated verification, lint promotion, formal anti-vacuity checks and agent evals.

plugins.name: dv
plugins.description: Evidence gate (dv:verify), agent-readable vplan, failure triage and review-comment-to-rule promotion for DV teams.

plugins.name: formal
plugins.description: Formal anti-vacuity gate for SVA (proof, cover witness, fault counterexample, assume audit), equivalence-proven refactors, and review comments promoted to lint/SVA rules. Works with whatever formal tool is installed.
